## RQ3 — Biomarker comparison

How do PD-1 (PDCD1) expression, immune-related gene signatures, and tumor mutational burden (TMB) compare in their association with different treatment responses?

Suggested tasks:

- Visualize the distribution of each biomarker in responders and non-responders using boxplots.

- Perform appropriate statistical tests to investigate whether each biomarker differs significantly between response groups.

- Compare the direction and magnitude of the observed differences, and discuss which biomarkers show stronger associations with treatment response.

- Explain the biological information captured by each biomarker and discuss their relative strengths and limitations

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
data <- readRDS("data/IMvigor210_plain.rds")

pheno <- data$clinical
expr  <- data$tpm[, match(pheno$sample_id, colnames(data$tpm))]
stopifnot(identical(pheno$sample_id, colnames(expr)))
```

```{r}
#| label: helper-functions

plot_Response_boxplot <- function(data, variable, y_label, test_result) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Response, y = .data[[variable]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.6) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0("p = ", signif(test_result$p.value, 3)),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Response class",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_association <- function(data, x, y, x_label, y_label, cor_test) {
  rho <- unname(cor_test$estimate)
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "Spearman rho = ", round(rho, 2),
        "\np = ", signif(cor_test$p.value, 3)
      ),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.3
    ) +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: calculate-gep

GEP_genes <- c(
  "CCL5", "CD27", "CD274", "CD276", "CD8A", "CMKLR1", "CXCL9",
  "CXCR6", "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-E", "IDO1", "LAG3",
  "NKG7", "PDCD1LG2", "PSMB10", "STAT1", "TIGIT"
)

GEP_genes_present <- GEP_genes[GEP_genes %in% rownames(expr)]
GEP_genes_missing <- setdiff(GEP_genes, rownames(expr))

cat("GEP genes present:", length(GEP_genes_present), "of", length(GEP_genes), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", paste(GEP_genes_missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Extract GEP genes.
GEP_expr <- expr[GEP_genes_present, , drop = FALSE]

# Standardize each gene across samples.
# scale() operates on columns, so transpose before and after scaling.
GEP_expr_scaled <- t(scale(t(GEP_expr)))

# Average standardized expression across GEP genes for each sample.
GEP_scores <- colMeans(GEP_expr_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)

summary(GEP_scores)
```

```{r}
#| label: create-analysis-data

df <- data.frame(
  sample = pheno$sample_id,
  TMB = pheno$TMB,
  PD1 = as.numeric(expr["PDCD1", ]),
  GEP_scores = GEP_scores,
  Response = factor(pheno$BOR)
)

stopifnot(identical(df$sample, colnames(expr)))

summary(df)

table(df$Response, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
#| label: test-Response-biomarkers
TMB_Response_test <- wilcox.test(TMB ~ Response, data = df)
PD1_Response_test <- wilcox.test(PD1 ~ Response, data = df)
GEP_Response_test <- wilcox.test(GEP_scores ~ Response, data = df)

TMB_Response_test
PD1_Response_test
GEP_Response_test
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-Response-biomarkers

plot_Response_boxplot(df, "TMB", "Tumor mutational burden", TMB_Response_test)
plot_Response_boxplot(df, "PD1", "PDCD1 expression", PD1_Response_test)
plot_Response_boxplot(df, "GEP_scores", "T cell–inflamed GEP score", GEP_Response_test)
```

```{r}
#| label: biomarker-correlations

PD1_GEP_cor <- cor.test(df$PD1, df$GEP_scores, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE, use = "complete.obs")
TMB_GEP_cor <- cor.test(df$TMB, df$GEP_scores, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE, use = "complete.obs")
TMB_PD1_cor <- cor.test(df$TMB, df$PD1, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE, use = "complete.obs")

PD1_GEP_cor
TMB_GEP_cor
TMB_PD1_cor
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-biomarker-correlations
plot_association(df, "PD1", "GEP_scores", "PDCD1 expression", "GEP score", PD1_GEP_cor)
plot_association(df, "TMB", "GEP_scores", "Tumor mutational burden", "GEP score", TMB_GEP_cor)
plot_association(df, "TMB", "PD1", "Tumor mutational burden", "PDCD1 expression", TMB_PD1_cor)
```
